title: 12-Lead ECG
author: R. Alvarez, MD
summary: Sinus bradycardia 46, first-degree AV block (PR 248 ms), wide QRS 124 ms, QTc 468 ms. No peaked T waves.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 46 bpm. PR 248 ms. QRS 124 ms. QT/QTc 534/468 ms.

**Interpretation**
Sinus bradycardia with first-degree AV block and a wide QRS. No peaked T waves. No dropped beats. Correlate clinically and with electrolytes.
impression: Sinus bradycardia 46, first-degree AV block, wide QRS. No peaked T waves.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: D. Okafor, MD
summary: Sinus bradycardia 40, first-degree AV block (PR 300 ms), QRS 136 ms (wide), QTc 480 ms. No dropped beats.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 40 bpm. PR 300 ms. QRS 136 ms. QT/QTc 588/480 ms.

**Interpretation**
Sinus bradycardia with marked first-degree AV block (PR longer than at 0430) and a wider QRS. No dropped beats. Compared with the 0430 tracing the rate is slower and the PR and QRS are longer.
impression: Sinus bradycardia 40, PR 300 ms, QRS 136 ms. Worse than 0430. No dropped beats.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: P. Raman, MD
summary: Sinus bradycardia 38, first-degree AV block (PR 320 ms), QRS 148 ms (very wide), QTc 492 ms, tall peaked T waves.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 38 bpm. PR 320 ms. QRS 148 ms. QT/QTc 618/492 ms.

**Interpretation**
Sinus bradycardia with marked first-degree AV block and a very wide QRS. Tall, narrow, peaked T waves, most obvious in V2 to V4. P waves are small. Worse than 1130. Correlate with potassium and magnesium.
impression: Sinus bradycardia 38, PR 320 ms, QRS 148 ms, tall peaked T waves. Worse than 1130.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: D. Okafor, MD
summary: Sinus rhythm 66, PR 204 ms, QRS 108 ms, QTc 486 ms (prolonged).
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 66 bpm. PR 204 ms. QRS 108 ms. QT/QTc 463/486 ms.

**Interpretation**
Sinus rhythm. The PR is at the upper limit and the QRS is nearly normal. No peaked T waves. The QT interval is prolonged. Much improved from 1330. Correlate with calcium.
impression: Sinus rhythm 66, PR 204 ms, QRS 108 ms, QTc 486 ms (prolonged). Much improved.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: J. Lindgren, MD
summary: Sinus bradycardia 54, first-degree AV block (PR 236 ms), QRS 114 ms, QTc 478 ms.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 54 bpm. PR 236 ms. QRS 114 ms. QT/QTc 504/478 ms.

**Interpretation**
Sinus bradycardia with first-degree AV block. The rate is slower and the PR longer than at 1830. No peaked T waves. Correlate with magnesium.
impression: Sinus bradycardia 54, PR 236 ms, QRS 114 ms. Slower and longer PR than 1830.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: J. Lindgren, MD
summary: Sinus rhythm 66, PR 212 ms, QRS 102 ms, QTc 462 ms. Improved.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 66 bpm. PR 212 ms. QRS 102 ms. QT/QTc 440/462 ms.

**Interpretation**
Sinus rhythm. PR at the upper limit of normal; QRS and QT normal. Improved compared with 0230.
impression: Sinus rhythm 66, PR 212 ms, QRS 102 ms, QTc 462 ms. Improved.
